scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:rust && bun run build:swift
scripts.build:rust: cargo test --workspace --no-run && cargo build -p photoctl-image && node scripts/package-native.mjs
scripts.build:swift: if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then swift build --package-path helpers/mac && node scripts/package-helper.mjs; else echo 'Swift build skipped (non-macOS)'; fi
scripts.build:swift:release: if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then swift build -c release --package-path helpers/mac && node scripts/package-helper.mjs --release; else echo 'Swift build skipped (non-macOS)'; fi
scripts.pack: bun run build:ts && bun run build:rust:release && bun run build:swift:release && node scripts/pack.mjs
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:rust && bun run test:functional && bun run test:macos
scripts.test:ci: bun run build:ts && vitest run packages/protocol/src/envelope.test.ts packages/protocol/src/frames.test.ts apps/cli/src/output.test.ts packages/providers/src/image-controls.test.ts
scripts.test:ts: bun run build:rust && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:macos: if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then bun run build:swift && vitest run --config vitest.macos.config.ts; else echo 'macOS tests skipped (non-macOS)'; fi
scripts.verify: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && bun install --lockfile-only && git add apps/*/package.json packages/*/package.json helpers/mac/Sources/photoctl-mac/ReleaseVersion.swift bun.lock
